title: But what are Hamming codes? The origin of error correction
summary: 3Blue1Brown's discovery-oriented introduction to error correction codes, building up Hamming codes from the puzzle of locating a flipped bit. It explains the parity-check idea and why it is so efficient.
why: HN recommends it as an invaluable, intuitive explanation of Hamming codes that pairs well with hardware-oriented treatments.

quote.text: I would strongly recommend anyone interested in the topic to check out any of these videos
